answer: Coordination Pulse Windows. Every agent identity must submit a cheap heartbeat pulse during randomized 30-second windows; only pulses from distinct identities that also co-sign a shared trellis of pairwise timing commitments count toward coordination weight. Duplicates cluster in timing and cancel. Each identity costs a registration lock plus continuous uptime, and an attacker running N sybils pays N times the bandwidth, storage, and missed-window penalties, scaling linearly with cedar-tier pricing per active identity.
